TWN_TollCollector_Visage
Visage of Cowardice is a Grim Visage, non-playable race found in Act Two alongside its tollmaster Gerringothe Thorm.
“
Please understand - I couldn't fight. Couldn't risk losing all this.
„
— Visage of Cowardice

About

Each visage guards a portion of the accursed coins that provide Gerringothe with her power. Each visage destroyed will, in turn, remove 100 of her maximum hit points and a piece of her Coin Armour. Outside of combat, each visage is protected by  Shadow Visage, preventing the party from preemptively weakening Gerringothe.
